rv.q: Overall, the mood was effervescent, unselfconsciously joyous and totally infectious: we were all drawn into the Tribe.
Skokie Theatre brings it all back with a fabulous interpretation of the rock musical, HAIR and its tribe, produced by Wendy Kaplan and Wayne Mell for Madkap Productions.
Hair at Skokie Theatre is a surefire winner playing through July 30.

cn.t: Critics praise this vibrant revival for its energetic performances and timeless relevance, with the production successfully capturing the spirit of the iconic counterculture musical.
